name: The Firefighter's Neglected Wife
overview: Bestselling romance author Edith has loved firefighter Nolan secretly for ten years. They enter a contractual marriage forced by Nolan’s father. After a café gas explosion, scheming Nancy lies about carrying Nolan’s baby, making Edith file for divorce. Nolan begs her to pretend to be a loving couple to calm his father awaiting heart surgery. Nancy moves in to stir trouble, fakes a miscarriage and frames Edith for plagiarism. Nolan discovers her hidden love in her novels and tries to win her back. Nancy accidentally kills Edith’s best friend Angie and is confined to a psychiatric institution indefinitely.When Nancy attacks Edith with scissors, Nolan shields her at risk. Moved by Nolan’s sincerity, Edith reconciles with him, and their loveless contract marriage turns into genuine love.
